area: Hidden vs shown bets: do the bets Tj's CNO-list filters hide (screen = EV, BOOKS, ODDS, NOT_LISTED, MISMATCH) beat the close or profit, and does each filter cost edge or save him from traps. Per-reason numbers, date halves, kinds, relaxation counterfactuals, same-bet overlap, candidate rules.
trust_notes: 1) COMPARABLE WINDOW. The wide read logged its first hidden bet at 2026-10-03 18:57 ET (v0.58.0). The 116 bets first listed 17:56-18:56 (v0.57.0) are all 'shown' with no hidden counterpart, so every hidden-vs-shown number here uses the window from 18:57 on: 1,964 bets, 180 games, 2.21 days (the app's own SUMMARY with all 2,080: shown 803 CLV +0.57%, hidden 1,277 CLV -0.30%; my window shown is 687 bets CLV +0.62%). 2) 'HIDDEN' IS A FIRST-LOOK LABEL. screen is set from the first look only. 397 of the 1,277 hidden bets (31%) were listed by the app later (328 by CNO's list, 69 by Vigilant's scan only), 36% of the EV-hidden ones. Only 880 (69%) were never shown at any look (median 3 looks, median life 9 minutes). I report hidden = screen set, never-shown = no c or v look ever, and later-shown separately. 3) CLOSE COVERAGE DIFFERS BY GROUP, AND SO DOES THE CLOSE. Closes exist for 44% of fresh CNO-list bets, 13.5% of never-shown ones (119 of 880) and 5% of never-shown props (24 of 496). Never-shown closes are 93 spread/total/moneyline closes (70 of them ESPN/DraftKings), 24 prop closes and 2 other. CLV against ESPN's DraftKings close runs about +1.4 points higher at the same EV, kind and time to start (regression coefficient +1.4 pts [-0.2, +3.1]), so hidden game-line CLV is flattered. Hidden CLV is NOT a like-for-like number; I add EV-, source-, kind- and time-adjusted comparisons. 4) DATE HALVES ARE LOPSIDED. Only 65 of 613 closes belong to bets first seen on Oct 5-6 (the loader's second half; the games are mostly not played yet). I also report a close-balanced time split (cut 2026-10-04 00:02 ET, 306 vs 307 closes). Every group's CLV is lower in the first half than the second (shown -0.48% then +1.82%), so a half is also a different app version (0.57-0.70.1) and preset mix. 5) SCREEN IS THE FIRST REASON FOUND (order MISMATCH, ONE_WAY, BOOKS, ODDS, TOO_GOOD, EV). The EV group therefore already passes books and odds; the BOOKS and ODDS groups may ALSO fail the EV floor (65% of each has EV under 1%). Every relaxation counterfactual below applies the other filters explicitly (a bet only counts when it would then pass them all). 6) NOT TESTABLE FROM THIS FILE: ONE_WAY, TOO_GOOD and NOT_A_GAME have zero bets (largest EV at any look 17.4%, none over 20%; cnoOneWay is false on all 1,732 bets that have the flag; the study skips rows with no start time), so those three filters are unevaluated; complete-book, both-sides and the row limit can only be seen inside NOT_LISTED (32 bets); what the Shared View link scopes out (sports, leagues, main lines) is never logged. 7) EV is comparable across the two reads: at the same minute the wide and list looks carry the same EV within 0.05 points on 93% of 5,361 paired looks (same conservative devig, code 8). 8) ROI: hidden groups carry about +/-6 points (95%, game-clustered) on ~700-1,000 settled bets while the edge in question is under 1 point: ROI cannot confirm or refute any hidden edge; CLV is used as the leading indicator and is itself thin for BOOKS (13 closes), ODDS (18), NOT_LISTED (12), MISMATCH (3). 9) Multiple comparisons: I looked at about 40 group x kind cells; at 5% about 2 would look 'significant' by luck. Where a cell is named as notable I give that count. Nothing here is out of sample in a strong sense: the file is ~2.2 days of first looks across versions 0.57-0.70.1.
key_numbers: Window (first hidden bet on, 2026-10-03 18:57 ET to 2026-10-06 00:05 ET): 1,964 bets, 180 games, 2.21 days; 613 closes in 59 games. Shown 687 bets (310/day, 127 games), CLV +0.62% [-0.18%, +1.53%] on 314 closes in 45 games, ROI -2.19% [-10.49%, +5.96%] on 571 settled, listed EV +2.35%. Hidden 1277 bets (577/day, 135 games), CLV -0.30% [-0.83%, +0.36%] on 299 closes in 49 games, ROI +2.69% [-2.94%, +9.71%] on 1020 settled, listed EV +0.54%.

Hidden minus shown CLV -0.92 pts [-1.85, -0.03] pts (p~0.043; 299 vs 314 closes, 59 games): hidden lists EV +0.54% vs shown +2.35%; CLV rises 0.68 points per listed-EV point (CI 0.23 to 1.09, 613 closes, 59 games), so the EV gap (1.8 pts x 0.7-0.85) predicts a gap of about -1.3 to -1.5: adjusted for EV, close source, kind and time to start the hidden dummy is +0.49% [-0.94%, +2.04%]: no hidden edge and no hidden damage.

ROI: hidden +2.69% [-2.94%, +9.71%] on 1020 settled vs shown -2.19% [-10.49%, +5.96%] on 571; difference +4.87 pts [-5.99, +18.64] pts (p~0.38; 1020 vs 571 settled, 72 games). Hidden ROI minus listed EV +2.1 pts [-3.5, +9.2]: noise. About 10,000 settled hidden bets (about 22 days at the study's rate) are needed to pin ROI to +/-2 pts.

Three groups, not two: never shown 880 bets (398/day, 122 games), CLV +0.28% [-0.36%, +0.90%] on 119 closes in 46 games, ROI +2.36% [-3.72%, +10.27%] on 710 settled, listed EV +0.53%; later shown by CNO or Vigilant 328 bets (148/day, 88 games), CLV -0.89% [-1.47%, -0.08%] on 139 closes in 32 games, ROI -2.33% [-14.15%, +13.36%] on 243 settled, listed EV +0.59% (CNO) and 69 bets (31/day, 21 games), CLV +0.02% [-0.93%, +1.18%] on 41 closes in 16 games, ROI +24.39% [+5.45%, +48.75%] on 67 settled, listed EV +0.44% (Vigilant only); fresh CNO-list bets 397 bets (179/day, 92 games), CLV +1.05% [+0.08%, +1.94%] on 176 closes in 36 games, ROI -0.58% [-12.44%, +12.55%] on 310 settled, listed EV +2.22%.

397 of 1277 hidden bets (31.1%) were later listed by the app: EV 341/955 (35.7%), BOOKS 23/147 (15.6%), ODDS 3/127 (2.4%), NOT_LISTED 28/32 (87.5%), MISMATCH 2/16 (12.5%); first-look to first-shown lag median 42 min (p25 7, p75 167); the share is 35%, 30%, 30% on Oct 3, 4, 5. 234 of 687 shown bets (34%) also had a later look under 1% (EV flickers around the floor).

Bets first hidden then shown by the CNO list: CLV at the hidden first price -0.89% [-1.47%, -0.06%] vs +0.16% [-0.41%, +0.97%] at the price the list showed (139 closes, 32 games); paired waiting gain +1.04% [+0.78%, +1.33%] (EV +0.59% to +1.82%). At the shown price they are weaker than fresh CNO bets (+1.05%): -0.89 pts [-2.00, +0.43] pts (p~0.190; 139 vs 176 closes, 40 games), not significant.

EV floor (screen EV, 1% floor): 955 bets (431/day, 131 games), CLV -0.29% [-0.83%, +0.36%] on 253 closes in 46 games, ROI +4.86% [-0.65%, +11.62%] on 760 settled, listed EV +0.36%. Never shown part 614 bets (277/day, 111 games), CLV +0.51% [+0.00%, +1.09%] on 94 closes in 42 games, ROI +7.20% [+1.37%, +13.83%] on 494 settled, listed EV +0.31%; later-shown part 341 bets (154/day, 88 games), CLV -0.77% [-1.46%, +0.08%] on 159 closes in 32 games, ROI +0.53% [-10.86%, +15.40%] on 266 settled, listed EV +0.43%.

EV bands (all bets, window): under 1% CLV -0.37% [-0.92%, +0.33%] on 281 closes in 49 games; 1% to 2.5% CLV -0.19% [-1.01%, +0.63%] on 203 closes in 41 games; 2.5% and over CLV +1.92% [+0.75%, +3.22%] on 129 closes in 33 games. Differences: 2.5%+ minus under-1% +2.29 pts [+0.91, +3.65] pts (p~0.002; 129 vs 281 closes, 54 games); 2.5%+ minus 1-2.5% +2.11 pts [+0.66, +3.61] pts (p~0.003; 129 vs 203 closes, 47 games); 1-2.5% minus under-1% +0.17 pts [-0.60, +0.99] pts (p~0.706; 203 vs 281 closes, 57 games). The 1% floor sits in a flat part of the curve; CLV crosses zero near a listed EV of 1.29% [0.22%, 2.46%] (intercept -0.87% [-1.52%, -0.08%]).

EV-floor counterfactual (extra bets/day at the first-look price, CLV, ROI): 0.75% floor 57/day CLV +0.33% [-0.42%, +1.23%], ROI +10.63% [-8.87%, +25.83%]; 0.5% 131/day CLV -0.03% [-0.76%, +0.83%]; 0.25% 242/day CLV -0.09% [-0.69%, +0.67%]; 0% chip 431/day CLV -0.29% [-0.83%, +0.36%], ROI +4.86% [-0.65%, +11.62%]. Of the 0% floor's 431/day, 154/day are bets the list shows anyway later (bought earlier at CLV -0.77%), 277/day are net new (CLV +0.51% [+0.00%, +1.09%] on 94 closes, 17 of them props).

Odds cap: ODDS group 127 bets (57/day, 57 games), CLV +0.29% [-2.68%, +2.60%] on 18 closes in 15 games, ROI -5.92% [-27.06%, +18.36%] on 109 settled, listed EV +0.99%; only 43 of 127 (19/day) also pass the EV floor; raising the cap to +200 adds 27 bets (12/day, 2 closes, CLV -0.48%, ROI +45.63% [-7.22%, +99.53%] on 24 settled); no cap adds 43 (19/day, 3 closes). Undecidable: about 105 games with a close (about 885 ODDS bets, about 15 days) would give +/-1 pt.

Books: BOOKS group 147 bets (66/day, 43 games), CLV -2.24% [-6.78%, +0.65%] on 13 closes in 8 games, ROI -12.00% [-26.07%, +10.36%] on 111 settled, listed EV +1.07%; vs shown CLV -2.86 pts [-7.96, +0.39] pts (p~0.094; 13 vs 314 closes, 45 games); ROI vs shown -9.81 pts [-28.16, +17.53] pts (p~0.38; 111 vs 571 settled, 58 games). Lowering min books to 3 adds 28 bets (13/day, ROI -38.25% [-74.27%, +1.94%] on 20 settled, 2 closes); to 2 adds 46 (21/day, ROI -24.95% [-50.51%, +2.98%], 3 closes). Only 9% of BOOKS bets have a close; about 2,000 BOOKS bets (about 31 days) would give +/-1 pt.

NOT_LISTED 32 bets (14/day, 23 games), CLV +0.80% [-1.45%, +2.93%] on 12 closes in 11 games, ROI +21.97% [-16.25%, +76.72%] on 24 settled, listed EV +1.59%: 28 of 32 were listed by the app a median 1 minute later (timing, not a rule); MISMATCH 16 bets (7/day, 7 games), CLV -0.18% [-2.14%, +3.47%] on 3 closes in 3 games, ROI +30.80% [+4.12%, +74.09%] on 16 settled, listed EV +1.09%: 14 of 16 never shown, 3 closes: cannot be judged.

Same games: 765 of 880 never-shown bets (87%) and 107 of 119 of their closes are on games that also have a shown bet. Paired per game (never-shown minus shown) -1.12 pts [-2.58, +0.18] pts over 34 games; paired inside the same game, close source and kind type -1.45 pts [-2.80, -0.07] pts over 45 cells.

Kinds: hidden props CLV -0.66% [-1.45%, +0.12%] (168 closes) vs shown props +0.55% [-0.38%, +1.51%]: -1.21 pts [-2.43, -0.07] pts (p~0.037; 168 vs 262 closes, 32 games); hidden spreads +0.92% [+0.10%, +1.76%] on 47 closes, 27 of them ESPN: the one hidden cell whose CI clears zero, about 1 in 20 cells expected by chance.

Inside the CNO list itself (725 bets, 328/day, window; CLV at the first shown price): list EV 1-2% 473 bets (214/day) CLV -0.51% [-1.12%, +0.14%] on 167 closes in 36 games; 2-3% 160 bets (72/day) +0.91% [-0.06%, +1.83%] on 84 closes in 27 games; 3% and over 92 bets (42/day) +3.35% [+1.77%, +4.95%] on 64 closes in 22 games.
Close coverage: never-shown bets have a close for 13.5% (119/880) vs 44% for fresh CNO-list bets (176/397); never-shown props 5% (24/496) vs shown props 54% (262/490).
Time to start: hidden bets are 76% of those first seen under 30 minutes before the start; CLV under 30 min: hidden +0.79% [+0.03%, +1.54%] (48 closes) vs shown +2.45% [+1.00%, +3.78%] (34 closes).

findings.claim: The hidden bets do not beat the close and are not where the profit is; their CLV is lower than shown CLV, by about what their lower listed EV predicts.
findings.evidence: Window: hidden 1277 bets (577/day, 135 games), CLV -0.30% [-0.83%, +0.36%] on 299 closes in 49 games, ROI +2.69% [-2.94%, +9.71%] on 1020 settled, listed EV +0.54%; shown 687 bets (310/day, 127 games), CLV +0.62% [-0.18%, +1.53%] on 314 closes in 45 games, ROI -2.19% [-10.49%, +5.96%] on 571 settled, listed EV +2.35%. CLV difference -0.92 pts [-1.85, -0.03] pts (p~0.043; 299 vs 314 closes, 59 games). Against the fresh CNO-list bets alone (the group the CNO filters define; shown also holds 290 Vigilant-scan-only bets): hidden minus fresh-CNO -1.35 pts [-2.46, -0.16] pts (p~0.03; 299 vs 176 closes, 50 games), never-shown minus fresh-CNO -0.78 pts [-1.98, +0.48] pts (p~0.21; 119 vs 176 closes, 48 games); hidden minus Vigilant-only -0.38 pts [-1.94, +1.03] pts. EV-adjusted (EV + close source + kind + time-to-start fixed effects, 613 closes, 59 games) the hidden dummy is +0.49% [-0.94%, +2.04%]; split in two, never-shown +0.81% [-1.52%, +2.88%], later-shown +0.40% [-0.87%, +1.80%]. By reason (EV-adjusted, same model): EV +0.66% [-0.76%, +2.24%], BOOKS -1.38% [-6.51%, +2.55%], ODDS +0.44% [-2.83%, +3.22%], NOT_LISTED +0.57% [-2.07%, +2.79%], MISMATCH +0.04% [-3.27%, +4.93%]. ROI: hidden +2.69% [-2.94%, +9.71%] vs shown -2.19% [-10.49%, +5.96%], difference +4.87 pts [-5.99, +18.64] pts (p~0.38; 1020 vs 571 settled, 72 games). Halves: loader split hidden minus shown H1 -1.03 pts (264 vs 284 closes), H2 -0.11 pts (35 vs 30 closes); close-balanced split -0.58 pts [-1.94, +0.90] pts (p~0.419; 143 vs 163 closes, 44 games) and -1.42 pts [-2.86, -0.14] pts (p~0.035; 156 vs 151 closes, 36 games).
findings.effect: CLV hidden minus shown -0.92 pts [-1.85, -0.03] pts; EV-adjusted hidden effect +0.49% [-0.94%, +2.04%]
findings.luck_risk: The raw gap is nominally p~0.04 but it is the planned primary contrast and the EV gap explains it; the EV-adjusted effect is zero within +/-1.5 pts, so 'hidden beats the close' is not supported (chance it is real and above +1 pt is small but not excluded: the CI reaches +2.0 pts). H2 (loader) is only 35 vs 30 closes.

findings.claim: 'Hidden' is mostly a snapshot: 31% of hidden bets (36% of EV-hidden ones) were listed by the app later, at a better price; the same bet is hidden at one moment and shown at another.
findings.evidence: 397/1277 later shown (by the CNO list 328, by Vigilant's scan only 69); by reason EV 341/955, BOOKS 23/147, ODDS 3/127, NOT_LISTED 28/32, MISMATCH 2/16. First-look to first-shown lag median 42 min (p25 7, p75 167, p90 479); EV at the first look mean 0.57% rising to 1.86% at the first shown look. By first-look day the later-shown share is 34.8%, 29.9%, 29.5%. 234 of 687 shown bets (184 of 397 fresh CNO bets) also had a later look under 1%: the floor is crossed back and forth. Of the 614 never-shown EV bets, 607 never reached 1% at any look (mean peak EV 0.43%, median 0.38%); never-shown bets are short-lived (median 3 looks, 9 minutes; 44% seen once or twice).
findings.effect: 31.1% of hidden bets later shown (EV 35.7%, BOOKS 15.6%, ODDS 2.4%, NOT_LISTED 87.5%, MISMATCH 12.5%)
findings.luck_risk: A count, not an estimate: same on each day (35/30/30%).

findings.claim: Buying a bet at the moment the list first shows it beats buying it at the earlier hidden look: waiting gained about 1.0 CLV point; but EV that rises into the list from under 1% is (not significantly) weaker than EV that was there at the first look.
findings.evidence: hid-then-CNO-shown bets: CLV at the hidden price -0.89% [-1.47%, -0.06%], at the shown price +0.16% [-0.41%, +0.97%] (139 closes, 32 games); paired gain +1.04% [+0.78%, +1.33%] (H1 +1.08% on 124 closes, H2 +0.73% on 15; close-balanced halves +0.81% and +1.23%). Fresh CNO-list bets +1.05% [+0.08%, +1.93%] (176 closes). Difference at the shown price -0.89 pts [-2.00, +0.43] pts (p~0.190; 139 vs 176 closes, 40 games). ROI at the shown price -1.56% [-13.70%, +14.45%] on 241 settled. Vigilant-found later-shown bets: CLV -0.01% [-0.97%, +1.11%] on 41 closes (the 'ROI +24%' on 67 settled has a CI of +5% to +49% but its CLV is zero).
findings.effect: waiting gain +1.04% [+0.78%, +1.33%] (mostly the price difference by construction); weaker-than-fresh -0.89 pts [-2.00, +0.43] pts
findings.luck_risk: The waiting gain is mostly mechanical (the later price is better), so it is not luck. The 'weaker than fresh' part is p~0.19: likely luck; about 130 more close-games would be needed to see a 0.9-pt difference reliably.

findings.claim: The EV floor at 1% sits in a flat part of the CLV curve: bets under 1%, 1-2.5% and above all behave alike until 2.5%, where CLV is about +1.9 points higher; the 1% floor neither costs nor saves measurable edge, the edge starts higher.
findings.evidence: Under 1%: CLV -0.37% [-0.92%, +0.33%] on 281 closes in 49 games; 1-2.5%: CLV -0.19% [-1.01%, +0.63%] on 203 closes in 41 games; 2.5%+: CLV +1.92% [+0.75%, +3.22%] on 129 closes in 33 games. Contrasts: +2.29 pts [+0.91, +3.65] pts (p~0.002; 129 vs 281 closes, 54 games); 2.5%+ vs 1-2.5% +2.11 pts [+0.66, +3.61] pts (p~0.003; 129 vs 203 closes, 47 games); 1-2.5% vs under 1% +0.17 pts [-0.60, +0.99] pts (p~0.706; 203 vs 281 closes, 57 games). Slope 0.68 CLV points per EV point (CI 0.23 to 1.09), intercept -0.87%, zero at listed EV 1.29% [0.22%, 2.46%]; slope in shown only 0.86, hidden only 0.61 (CI -0.10 to 1.34). Finer bands (screen EV, first-look price): [0,0.25%) CLV -0.57% [-1.28%, +0.24%] on 106 closes in 40 games; [0.25,0.5) CLV -0.18% [-1.17%, +0.79%] on 63 closes in 29 games; [0.5,0.75) CLV -0.32% [-1.58%, +0.94%] on 47 closes in 25 games; [0.75,1.0) CLV +0.33% [-0.42%, +1.23%] on 37 closes in 16 games. By close-balanced halves 2.5%+ minus under-1%: +1.4 pts (first half 55 vs 138 closes) and +2.8 pts (second half 74 vs 143); loader halves 2.5%+ +1.97% (114 closes) / +1.59% (15), under-1% -0.47% / +0.46%. Inside the CNO list itself (725 bets, 328/day, CLV at the first shown price): list EV 1-2% 214/day -0.51% [-1.12%, +0.14%] (167 closes, 36 games); 2-3% 72/day +0.91% [-0.06%, +1.83%] (84 closes, 27 games); 3%+ 42/day +3.35% [+1.77%, +4.95%] (64 closes, 22 games).
findings.luck_risk: 2.5%+ vs under-1% is p~0.002 on a planned contrast (3 contrasts, so about 0.006 corrected); the 1-2.5% vs under-1% flatness is a non-significant result (CI +/-0.8 pts), not proof of equality.

findings.claim: Lowering the CNO list's minimum EV below 1% would add 57 to 431 bets a day with no measurable CLV or ROI gain; 36% (at the 0% floor; 43% to 54% at the higher floors) of the added bets are ones the list shows anyway later at a better price, so buying them earlier costs about 1 CLV point.
findings.evidence: floor 0.75%: 126 bets 57/day, 37 closes, CLV +0.33% [-0.42%, +1.23%], ROI +10.63% [-8.87%, +25.83%] on 102 settled; of which net-new 26/day CLV +1.65% (13 closes), swapped 31/day CLV -0.39% (24 closes); floor 0.5%: 289 bets 131/day, 84 closes, CLV -0.03% [-0.76%, +0.83%], ROI +5.99% [-4.39%, +16.98%] on 227 settled; of which net-new 69/day CLV +1.18% (27 closes), swapped 61/day CLV -0.61% (57 closes); floor 0.25%: 536 bets 242/day, 147 closes, CLV -0.09% [-0.69%, +0.67%], ROI +4.52% [-2.09%, +11.92%] on 427 settled; of which net-new 139/day CLV +0.66% (50 closes), swapped 103/day CLV -0.48% (97 closes); floor 0%: 955 bets 431/day, 253 closes, CLV -0.29% [-0.83%, +0.36%], ROI +4.86% [-0.65%, +11.62%] on 760 settled; of which net-new 277/day CLV +0.51% (94 closes), swapped 154/day CLV -0.77% (159 closes). The net-new 0% part looks positive (+0.51% [0.00%, +1.09%], 94 closes, 42 games) but: 58 of its 94 closes are ESPN/DraftKings, 20 Tracker, 8 Novig trades, 8 Pinnacle; 77 are spread/total/moneyline closes and only 17 are props (324 never-shown EV props have 17 closes); close-balanced halves +0.06% (45 closes) then +0.93% (49); EV-adjusted never-shown effect +0.81% [-1.52%, +2.88%]. The list's 1% floor does not bind auto-bet (its own floor is 2.5%, SettingsScreen Shadowed.autoBetEdge): it only changes what Tj sees in the CNO tab and widget.
findings.luck_risk: Net-new positive CLV: close-source biased and halves are +0.06% / +0.93%; I would put the chance it is luck or close-source artefact above 50%. Precision is not the problem (half-width already 0.55 pts on 94 closes in 42 games); the bias is: it needs closes that are not ESPN/DraftKings and a way to pick never-shown bets before the fact.

findings.claim: Books filter (CNO min 4 books): the only screen reason whose CLV and ROI both lean negative, but on 13 closes it cannot be called; it would add only 21 bets/day if relaxed (the rest also fail EV or odds).
findings.evidence: 147 bets (66/day, 43 games), CLV -2.24% [-6.78%, +0.65%] on 13 closes in 8 games, ROI -12.00% [-26.07%, +10.36%] on 111 settled, listed EV +1.07%; never shown 124 of 147. By books: 2-book group 65 bets CLV -0.90% on 6 closes, ROI -9.91%; 3-book group 81 bets CLV -3.38% [-10.36%, +1.63%] on 7 closes, ROI -13.86% [-36.35%, +5.65%]. CLV vs shown -2.86 pts [-7.96, +0.39] pts (p~0.094; 13 vs 314 closes, 45 games); ROI vs shown -9.81 pts [-28.16, +17.53] pts (p~0.38; 111 vs 571 settled, 58 games); EV-adjusted BOOKS effect -1.38% [-6.51%, +2.55%]. 126 of 147 are props. CNO-consensus drift (last look within 60 min of the start, a proxy for the close) points the other way: BOOKS +1.83% [+0.98%, +4.99%] on 19 bets in 7 games (shown +0.69% on 103). Relaxed to 3 books: 28 bets (13/day) ROI -38.25% [-74.27%, +1.94%] on 20 settled, 2 closes; to 2 books: 46 (21/day) ROI -24.95% [-50.51%, +2.98%], 3 closes. Halves: 12 closes in H1 (-2.29%), 1 in H2.
findings.luck_risk: Two negative signs with a p of about 0.09 (CLV) and 0.3 (ROI) on a post-hoc cell: roughly a one-in-three chance of luck; contradicted by the consensus-drift proxy. About 110 close-games (about 2,000 BOOKS bets, 31 days at 66/day, if close coverage stays 9%) would give +/-1 pt.

findings.claim: Odds cap (+150): cannot be judged; only 43 of the 127 hidden-by-odds bets would otherwise pass (19/day), with 3 closes.
findings.evidence: 127 bets (57/day, 57 games), CLV +0.29% [-2.68%, +2.60%] on 18 closes in 15 games, ROI -5.92% [-27.06%, +18.36%] on 109 settled, listed EV +0.99%; bands: +151..+175 69 bets CLV -1.27% on 7 closes ROI +4.05%; +176..+200 19 bets 4 closes ROI +34.00%; +201..+300 31 bets CLV +2.24% on 7 closes ROI -35.62%; over +300 8 bets 0 closes ROI -100% (6 settled). Passing EV 1%+: cap +175 20 bets, +200 27, +250 35, no cap 43 (CLV +1.33% on 3 closes; ROI +6.87% [-36.53%, +53.85%] on 39 settled). CLV vs shown -0.34 pts [-3.79, +2.34] pts (p~0.835; 18 vs 314 closes, 48 games); ROI vs shown -3.73 pts [-26.53, +21.47] pts (p~0.75; 109 vs 571 settled, 64 games). Also the auto-bet's own odds cap is +150 (Shadowed.autoBetOdds), so a CNO cap change alone does not change what it bets.
findings.luck_risk: Indistinguishable from zero in both directions; about 105 close-games (about 885 ODDS bets, 15 days) would give +/-1 pt.

findings.claim: NOT_LISTED and MISMATCH are timing and read artefacts, not filters that hide anything: 28 of 32 NOT_LISTED bets were listed by the app a median 1 minute later; MISMATCH has 16 bets.
findings.evidence: NOT_LISTED 32 bets (14/day, 23 games), CLV +0.80% [-1.45%, +2.93%] on 12 closes in 11 games, ROI +21.97% [-16.25%, +76.72%] on 24 settled, listed EV +1.59%; 28 listed later (lag median 1 min); never-shown 4. MISMATCH 16 bets (7/day, 7 games), CLV -0.18% [-2.14%, +3.47%] on 3 closes in 3 games, ROI +30.80% [+4.12%, +74.09%] on 16 settled, listed EV +1.09%, 14 never shown, wide-read EV differs from the row's fair odds by more than 0.5 points (rounding/read timing). The complete-book, both-sides and row-limit rules cannot be separated inside NOT_LISTED (no field says which).
findings.effect: NOT_LISTED CLV +0.80% [-1.45%, +2.93%] on 12 closes; MISMATCH -0.18% on 3 closes
findings.luck_risk: Not estimable: 12 and 3 closes. About 150 NOT_LISTED bets (about 10 days) would give +/-1 pt but the group is mostly the same bets as the list.

findings.claim: Kinds inside the hidden group: hidden props have worse CLV than shown props; hidden game lines look neutral to positive but are measured against softer ESPN closes; no hidden kind is a strategy.
findings.evidence: Props: hidden CLV -0.66% [-1.45%, +0.12%] on 168 closes in 27 games vs shown CLV +0.55% [-0.38%, +1.51%] on 262 closes in 29 games: -1.21 pts [-2.43, -0.07] pts (p~0.037; 168 vs 262 closes, 32 games); never-shown props have 24 closes of 496. Game lines: hidden CLV +0.16% [-0.46%, +0.78%] on 122 closes in 46 games; shown CLV +0.88% [-0.63%, +2.37%] on 35 closes in 22 games; -0.71 pts [-2.37, +1.12] pts (p~0.425; 122 vs 35 closes, 57 games). Within the hidden group: spreads +0.92% [+0.10%, +1.76%] (47 closes, 27 ESPN, 14 Tracker; loader halves +0.87% on 41 and +1.31% on 6; close-balanced +0.92% / +0.93%); totals -0.29% on 46 closes; moneylines -0.37% [-1.76%, +0.87%] on 29 closes with ROI -31.7% [-57.9%, -9.7%] on 30 settled; period lines 2 closes. By screen reason and kind: EV props -0.67% [-1.43%, +0.08%] on 141 closes; EV spreads +0.50% on 38; EV totals -0.26% on 45; EV moneylines +0.77% on 21; BOOKS props -2.24% on 13; ODDS spreads +3.28% on 7 (CI +2.2% to +4.5%); ODDS moneylines -3.57% on 7. ESPN-close premium in the regression +1.4 pts [-0.2, +3.1]. About 40 cells examined: 2 'significant' by chance expected; hidden spreads (nominal p~0.03), hidden moneylines' ROI and ODDS spreads are the ones that cleared it.
findings.effect: hidden props minus shown props -1.21 pts [-2.43, -0.07] pts; hidden spreads +0.92% [+0.10%, +1.76%]
findings.luck_risk: Hidden spreads: nominal p~0.03; with about 20 group x kind cells, the chance at least one clears p<0.05 is about 64%, so likely luck plus the ESPN close; props gap: p~0.04, consistent with EV.

findings.claim: The never-shown hidden bets are the same games as the shown ones, against the same closes, so 'hidden beats the close' is not an independent test; inside the same games and close sources hidden is lower, not higher.
findings.evidence: 765 of 880 never-shown bets and 107 of 119 of their closes are on games with a shown bet (74 of 122 games with never-shown bets also have shown bets). Per-game paired CLV (never-shown minus shown) -1.12 pts [-2.58, +0.18] pts over 34 games; all hidden minus shown -0.98 pts [-2.25, +0.35] pts over 35 games; same game + same close source + same kind type -1.45 pts [-2.80, -0.07] pts over 45 cells. Both sides of one market: only 54 over/under markets (108 bets, 5%) have both sides logged, 3 overlapping in time, so two-sided duplicates do not drive the numbers.
findings.luck_risk: The paired-cell CI barely excludes zero (p~0.04) after I chose this pairing; treat as 'not better', not as 'worse'.

findings.claim: Hidden bets are mostly un-gradable for CLV: the CLV comparison rests on 119 never-shown closes (13.5%) against 44% for fresh list bets; for hidden props almost none.
findings.evidence: never-shown: 119/880 closes ({'espn': 70, 'tracker': 28, 'pinnacle': 11, 'novig_trades': 10}), props 24/496, lines 93/332; fresh CNO: 176/397 ({'tracker': 86, 'novig_trades': 85, 'espn': 4, 'pinnacle': 1}), props 150/273; later-shown CNO 139/328. Most common reason for no close (SUMMARY): 393 props without a Pinnacle close in ParlayAPI's file.

findings.claim: ROI cannot tell whether hidden bets profit: hidden ROI +2.69% and never-shown EV props +10.4% are inside noise of +/-6 to +/-9 points at their listed EV of +0.5%.
findings.evidence: Hidden ROI +2.69% [-2.94%, +9.71%] on 1020 settled; EV-hidden +4.86% [-0.65%, +11.62%] on 760; never-shown EV +7.20% [+1.37%, +13.83%] on 494 (EV listed +0.31%, so the excess is +6.9 pts, about 2.2 standard errors on one of about 20 cells). Hidden minus shown ROI +4.87 pts [-5.99, +18.64] pts (p~0.38; 1020 vs 571 settled, 72 games). Needed for +/-2 pts: about 10,209 settled hidden bets (about 22 days at the study rate) or about 9,208 BOOKS bets (about 180 days).
findings.luck_risk: High: ROI at +0.5% EV is dominated by variance; this is what chance looks like.

findings.claim: Time to start explains a lot of CLV and the hidden group is concentrated near the start; hidden CLV is below shown CLV in three of the four time buckets that have 30+ closes on both sides.
findings.effect: hidden CLV below shown CLV in 3 of 4 buckets with 30+ closes each side
findings.luck_risk: Moderate; bucket cells are thin (30-50 closes each).

findings.claim: Which filter is worth the most to keep and which is the most expensive: no filter is proven to cost edge; the EV filter is the only one with evidence of value, but at 2.5% not at 1%; the Books filter may save the most but is unproven.
findings.evidence: Edge-units a day if every hidden bet in a group were taken at 1 unit at its first-look price (bets/day x CLV; for scale only, 400 bets a day is not placeable): EV floor -1.27 u/day (CI -3.6 to +1.6); of which net-new +1.43 u/day (CI +0.0 to +3.0) and swapped -1.19 (CI -2.3 to +0.1); BOOKS -1.49 (CI -4.5 to +0.4); ODDS +0.17 (CI -1.5 to +1.5); NOT_LISTED +0.12 (CI -0.2 to +0.4). Every interval contains zero. Ranking by point estimate: most expensive = the never-shown part of the EV floor (+0.51%, close-source biased, offset by the earlier-price cost on the swapped part); most valuable = BOOKS (-2.24% on 13 closes). ONE_WAY, TOO_GOOD and NOT_A_GAME have no bets in the file and cannot be ranked. The CNO list's EV floor does not bind auto-bet (floor 2.5%), alerts (2.5% or 4%) or the odds cap (auto-bet +150 too).
findings.effect: all hidden-reason CLV intervals include zero
findings.luck_risk: The ranking is within noise; do not act on it.

findings.claim: CLV is unstable over time: every group's CLV is lower in the first half of the study than in the second, so any half-versus-half statement is also an app-version and preset statement.
findings.evidence: Close-balanced halves: shown -0.48% (163 closes) then +1.82% (151); hidden -1.06% (143) then +0.40% (156); never-shown -0.31% then +0.82%; fresh CNO +0.44% then +1.46%. 14 app versions (0.57.0 to 0.70.1) and 6 presets over 2.2 days.
findings.effect: first-half CLV below second-half CLV for every group
findings.luck_risk: Differences are 1.5 to 2.5 points on 150 to 300 closes: not luck, but confounded with version.

app_changes_implied: PROPOSAL (answer first): leave the CNO list's three filters as they are (CnoFilters in data/cno/CnoModels.kt: minEv 1%, maxOdds +150, minBooks 4; Presets.kt VOLUME). Nothing in the hidden bets shows lost edge: the hidden CLV gap (-0.92 pts) is what their listed EV predicts and the EV-adjusted hidden effect is +0.5 pts [-0.9, +2.0]. No loosening is recommended; none is a safety question for auto-bet because the CNO list's floor (1%) is under auto-bet's own floor (2.5%).

QUESTION FOR TJ (a tightening, not a loosening): should the CNO list's minimum edge chip go from 1% to 2% or 3% (ScanSettings.CNO_MIN_EV_CHOICES = 0, 1, 2, 3 percent; Settings > CrazyNinjaOdds list)? Evidence: 1% to 2.5% shows no CLV over the under-1% bets (+0.17 pts [-0.60, +0.99]) while 2.5% and over beats them by +2.3 pts [+0.9, +3.7] (p~0.002, both halves). Inside the CNO list (725 bets, 328/day; CLV at the first shown price): list EV 1-2% is 214/day at -0.51% [-1.12%, +0.14%] (167 closes); 2-3% is 72/day at +0.91% [-0.06%, +1.83%] (84 closes); 3%+ is 42/day at +3.35% [+1.77%, +4.95%] (64 closes). A 2% chip would leave about 114/day, a 3% chip about 42/day. It changes the display and the widget only, not auto-bet (floor 2.5%) or alerts (2.5% or 4%). About 70 more closes at 2.5%+ would tighten the +1.7% [+0.6, +3.0] estimate to +/-1 pt.

QUESTION FOR TJ: if he wants to see the hidden bets, keep them log-only (ScanSettings.scanStudyHidden, already on). Showing them (CNO min EV chip 0%) would add about 431 bets/day with CLV -0.29% [-0.83%, +0.36%] (253 closes) and no ROI evidence (+4.9% [-0.7%, +11.6%], noise); 36% of them are bets the list shows later at a better price (about 1 CLV point better).

QUESTION FOR TJ, data first: raise the CNO max-odds chip (CNO_MAX_ODDS_CHOICES: 100, 150, 200, 300, no cap) or lower min books (CNO_MIN_BOOKS_CHOICES: 1-4) only after the log has about 105 close-games of ODDS bets (about 885 bets, 15 days) and about 110 close-games of BOOKS bets (about 2,000 bets, 31 days): today 18 and 13 closes. Relaxing odds to +200 adds 12 bets/day, books to 3 adds 12/day, to 2 adds 20/day (all that also pass EV 1%). Auto-bet's own odds cap is +150 (autoBetMaxOdds), so a CNO cap change alone would not change what it bets.

PROPOSAL, log-only first: a flag 'EV rose into the list from under the floor' (a bet whose wide-read looks were under 1% within the last two hours, then at 1%+) for TrapGuard (data/scanner/TrapGuard.kt) to be tested; today it is p~0.19 (-0.89 pts [-2.0, +0.4], 139 vs 176 closes), not enough for a rule.
next_logging: Close for EVERY logged bet from Novig's own last trades in the final 30 minutes (store trade count and last price on the bet, not only for bets Tj placed): never-shown bets have a close for 13.5% (119/880) and hidden props 5%; the study's Tracker close needs a placed bet. Cheap (public Novig reads; storage is not a constraint).

Log the CNO wide read's own last look as an explicit field: cnoCloseFair, cnoCloseBooks and minutes to start of that look (a consensus-drift proxy for every bet; I rebuilt it from the s arrays: correlation 0.81 with real CLV on 151 bets, but only 312 bets had a look within 60 min of the start).
Log ALL screen reasons as a set (EV+BOOKS+ODDS...), not only the first: 65% of BOOKS and 66% of ODDS bets also fail the EV floor, so 'which filter cost this bet' is not separable now.

Log, at every wide look, the app list's row count, the rank of the row in CNO's own order, whether the row was in the list (and why not: complete book, both sides, row limit, link scope), so NOT_LISTED (32 bets) becomes explainable; log the Shared View link's scope once and run a no-scope wide read hourly to count what the link hides (sports, leagues, main-lines-only, live): this is a blind spot today.

Write count-only lines for the rows the study drops before logging (futures without a start time, EV over 20%, one-way rows): ONE_WAY, TOO_GOOD and NOT_A_GAME have zero bets so those three filters cannot be evaluated.
Log prop closes from a sharp prop book (Kalshi, ProphetX through CNO's game page, the 'k' read) at 5 minutes to the start for hidden props: ParlayAPI's file has no Pinnacle close for 393 props.

Keep logging for 10 to 15 more days with the filters unchanged: about 10,000 settled hidden bets pin hidden ROI to +/-2 pts (22 days), and about 2,000 BOOKS bets / 885 ODDS bets pin their CLV to +/-1 pt (31 / 15 days).
